findings.claim: show() and select() re-read each card's lock but never move the selection off a card that has just become locked. `pick()` returns early for a locked id without touching `selected`, so the menu can end up with a card that is both aria-disabled and aria-checked, and RACE starts that locked track. This breaks the invariant that a locked card is never checked.
findings.evidence: Code: pick() `if (cards.find((c) => c.id === id)?.locked !== false) return;` leaves `selected` unchanged; show() is `refresh(); screen.show();`; select() is `card.setLocked(locked(trackId)); pick(trackId, false);`. Trace: 1) storage holds racer.finished.hay-loop, so createGame shows Pine Ridge unlocked. 2) Click Pine Ridge: selected='forest-ridge', aria-checked='true'. 3) RACE, then PAUSE. 4) Remove racer.finished.hay-loop (cleared in another tab or devtools; the design re-reads on every show for exactly this). 5) QUIT TO MENU runs game.showMenu(): select('forest-ridge') does setLocked(true) and pick() returns; show() refreshes. Now the Pine Ridge radio has aria-disabled='true' and aria-checked='true', startScreen.selected()==='forest-ridge', and clicking RACE calls enterRace('forest-ridge'), so game.state().trackId==='forest-ridge' on a locked track. Expected: Pine Ridge unchecked and a still-unlocked card selected. The `tracks` option doc (line 21, 'the first is selected') is also stale: the code now selects the first unlocked card.
findings.suggestedFix: In show(), after refresh(), re-validate the selection: `if (cards.find((c) => c.id === selected)?.locked) { const first = cards.find((c) => !c.locked); if (first) pick(first.id, false); }`. Do this in show(), not inside refresh(), because refresh() is first called before `let selected` is initialised (TDZ). Update the `tracks` doc to say 'first unlocked'.

checked.target: src/game.ts tick(): saveFinished on player finish
checked.how: Traced `finished` (read before stepWorld) against `racers[0].finishTick` after it. It saves once, on the null→non-null transition, in both frame() and play(). racePhase() returns 'finished' on that same condition, so the key is stored before draw()→ui.sync() shows results (AC6). Not called from src/sim, so determinism is untouched.

Both storage helpers wrap the `window.localStorage` access itself in try/catch, so Node, a throwing getter and a throwing setItem all read as locked or drop the write (AC8/AC9). nextTrackId keeps explicit `ids` unchanged and filters with `id === currentId || !isTrackLocked(id)` otherwise. The menu and NEXT RACE share isTrackLocked, so they can't disagree.

checked.target: src/ui/start-screen.ts init order, pick(), arrow handler, select(), show()
checked.how: refresh() runs before `let selected` but never reads it (no TDZ). Arrow index `(i + step*k + n*k) % n` is non-negative for k=1..n-1 and wraps correctly. I walked it for 4 cards with Pine Ridge locked: Dust Bowl→Hay Loop→Dust Bowl, Bends←→Hay Loop, and Hay Loop→Bends. Only gap found: F1.

The single padlock node is appended or removed, never duplicated. aria-describedby is reset on unlock. showBest() shows dashes whenever locked (even with a stored best) and restores the cached best on unlock. Ids come from the module counter, so they're unique across start screens.

Compared specificity: locked :hover/:focus-visible/:active (0,3,0) vs `@media (hover:hover) .ui-track-card:hover:not(:active)` (0,3,0, earlier in the file) vs `.ui-track-card:active` (0,2,0). The locked rules win by order or specificity, so no lift or sink, and the focus-ring outline is kept. The reduced-motion block doesn't conflict.

Walked the control points (lap ≈ 630). Both ramps sit on collinear diagonals with ≥ 25 straight units after the lip, slope 0.25. The four tips turn ≈ 72–94° over ≈ 20 units, so local radius ≈ 12–16, above half-width 5.5. All 47 fixed props are ≥ 15 from the centreline. The start straight is 42 units, so grid slots 0–5 sit on it.

Grep for Math.random, Date, performance.now, window, document and localStorage under src/sim finds only a comment in types.ts. The diff touches no sim file; G2 shows 0.0% change on existing tracks and G3 shows replays reproduce.

checked.target: Existing suites that touch the menu or NEXT RACE (track-select, gamepad-menu, pause-results, hay-loop, next-track)
checked.how: Re-derived each affected assertion by hand. Bends←→Hay Loop wrap still holds with Pine Ridge locked. nextTrackId('dust-bowl') is 'hay-loop' in Node, where `window` is absent and the track reads as locked. pause-results and gamepad-menu compute nextTrackId against the same storage the game just wrote.

The group's keydown runs before window's onDown. Arrows on the menu only add to the `down` set, which input.reset() clears at race start. Escape on the menu is ignored by setPaused (mode !== 'race'). A locked card is a div with tabindex -1, so it is reachable only by pointer. Clicking it moves focus but leaves selection unchanged.

checked.target: Layout below the 844×390 reference frame (not reported)
checked.how: From title.css the nowrap BEST line (~84 px, read from the screenshot) has only ~8 px slack at 844 and clips below roughly 790 px wide (e.g. 740×360); main's 3-card row fit down to ~680. AC10, UI_RULES §5 and the existing fit tests only cover 844×390 and 1440×900, so I left it out as outside the stated frame.

Read all new files. Each AC1–AC10 has an `AC<n>:` test; AC5/AC8/AC9 contain an assertion that fails on main. No existing test was edited, and no .skip/.only/@ts-ignore was added. Counted ≈ 22 new test cases; the +40 in gates is consistent with existing suites looping over TRACKS.

Confirmed each minor audit point is implemented: injectable `locked` reader for stages, select() ignoring locked ids, arrows and clicks skipping locks, no hover or press on locked cards, no shake, TRACK_LOCKS shape unchanged, and the 'must still pass' suites green in gates.
